_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Paper egg (minecraft-paper.yaml): the jar from Purpur's API v2 with its MD5 checked, a version or build that does not exist fails the install instead of installing another one, the eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 25 to 8 images (newest first, as Paper), Minecraft Java idle sleep, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Purpur
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Purpur is a drop-in replacement for Paper with more gameplay and performance options. Runs Paper, Spigot and Bukkit plugins.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Purpur installation (Octail): the jar from api.purpurmc.org (API v2), its MD5 checked.
# Purpur publishes only an MD5 per build. A version or build that doesn't exist fails the install
# instead of silently installing another one.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -eu

API=https://api.purpurmc.org/v2/purpur
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

PROJECT_JSON=$(get "${API}") || fail "can't reach the Purpur API (${API})"
if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
	VERSION=$(echo "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '.metadata.current // .versions[-1] // empty')
	[ -n "${VERSION}" ] || fail "the Purpur API named no current version"
fi
echo "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -e --arg v "${VERSION}" '.versions | index($v) != null' >/dev/null ||
	fail "Purpur has no Minecraft ${VERSION}. The versions are listed at https://purpurmc.org/download/purpur"

if [ -z "${BUILD}" ] || [ "${BUILD}" = "latest" ]; then
	BUILD=$(get "${API}/${VERSION}" | jq -r '.builds.latest // empty') || fail "can't list the builds of ${VERSION}"
	[ -n "${BUILD}" ] || fail "Purpur has no builds for ${VERSION}"
fi
case "${BUILD}" in
*[!0-9]*) fail "the build number (${BUILD}) must be a number or latest" ;;
esac

INFO=$(get "${API}/${VERSION}/${BUILD}") || fail "Purpur has no build ${BUILD} for ${VERSION}"
RESULT=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.result // empty')
[ "${RESULT}" = "SUCCESS" ] || fail "Purpur build ${BUILD} for ${VERSION} failed to build (${RESULT}). Pick another build."
MD5=$(echo "${INFO}" | jq -r '.md5 // empty' | tr 'A-F' 'a-f')
echo "${MD5}" | grep -Eq '^[0-9a-f]{32}$' || fail "the Purpur API gave no MD5 for build ${BUILD}"

echo "Installing Purpur ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} as ${JAR}"
rm -f "${JAR}.download"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "${JAR}.download" "${API}/${VERSION}/${BUILD}/download" ||
	fail "the download of Purpur ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} failed"
GOT=$(md5sum "${JAR}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${MD5}" ]; then
	rm -f "${JAR}.download"
	fail "MD5 mismatch for Purpur ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} (expected ${MD5}, got ${GOT})"
fi
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv "${JAR}.download" "${JAR}"

echo "Purpur ${VERSION} build ${BUILD} installed (MD5 ${MD5} checked)."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version to install, such as 1.21.11, or latest for the version Purpur marks as current. A version Purpur has no build for fails the install.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 25 for the newest releases, Java 21 for 1.20.5 to 1.21.x, Java 17 for 1.17 to 1.20.4, Java 8 or 11 before that.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: The Purpur build to install, or latest for the newest build of that Minecraft version.
